text: Cité Marine, the French producer of prepared seafood and vegetables based in Kervignac, appears in Nissui's Global Network (Overseas) Europe listing as 'Cite Marine S.A.S. (Food production and sales)'; Nissui (Nippon Suisan Kaisha) is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (Prime Market).
short: Cité Marine is part of the Nissui group, a Tokyo-listed Japanese seafood group.
